testsuite.name: com.chimali.fido2.bluetooth.BluetoothHidDeviceWrapperIncomingReportTest

testcase.name: truncated and oversized callback reports are rejected without fabricated padding()
outgoing stale session report is rejected before reaching Bluetooth()
outgoing platform report copy is erased when Bluetooth send throws()
active host disconnect advances generation and erases queued reports()
incoming report admission rejects another host and tags active session generation()
callback admission copies borrowed bytes bounds queue and erases undelivered owners()
never-bonded host is disconnected without becoming the active session()
outgoing platform report copy is erased after success rejection and driver failure()
unplug from another host preserves active report ownership()
host connecting during bond is deferred and cleared if it disconnects()
registration callback forwards connection reports and unplug through the real wrapper()
